rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
echo "\ ac_cv_path_EGREP='$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/grep -E' ac_cv_path_EXPR=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/expr ac_cv_path_GREP=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/grep ac_cv_path_M4=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/m4 ac_cv_path_PERL=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/perl ac_cv_path_SED=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/sed ac_cv_path_install='$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/install -c' ac_cv_path_mkdir=$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/mkdir " > config.site
export CONFIG_SITE="config.site"
# The programs and the data folder carry the version, so that the package # can be installed next to the current autoconf. ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --program-suffix=2.69
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make pkgdatadir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/autoconf2.69" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
# The manual would overwrite the one of the current autoconf. rm -rf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/info"
